$comment: Seasonal prices / promotions shown in the site popup. Edit this file to add, change, or remove offers. Each entry: id (unique slug), title, detail; optional cta {label, href} (Call and Email buttons are always shown); optional starts/ends as YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive) to auto show/hide. Only the first currently-active entry is shown, and only once per visitor.

promotions.title: Get a free price quote
promotions.detail: Call or email us with what your yard needs, and we'll get back to you with a free, no-obligation quote.
